# telnyx_phone_numbers_bulk_update_emergency_settings (Action)

Starts a job that updates the emergency settings of a batch of phone numbers.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emergency_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether to enable or disable emergency services on the numbers.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String)

### Optional

- `emergency_address_id` (String) Identifies the address to be used with emergency services. Required if emergency_enabled is true, must be null or omitted if emergency_enabled is false.
